Danish Malik And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15
April, 2024

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:64843
Court No. - 92
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 45820 of 2023
Applicant :- Danish Malik And 5 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Kulshrestha,Arvind Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Rajeev Kr. Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking quashing of the entire proceeding of Complaint Case No. 1979 of 2021 (Saman vs. Danish Malik and others) as well as summoning order dated 29.5.2023, u/s 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Kotwali, District Mainpuri, pending before Judicial Magistrate, Court No.2, Mainpuri.

entities.text: Complaint Case No. 1979 of 2021 (Saman vs. Danish Malik and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. From the perusal of the record, it appears that on the statement of the counsel for the applicants that there were chances of mediation, this matter was sent to the mediation centre by order dated 18.1.2024 with a direction that the applicants would deposit Rs. 30,000/- before mediation centre.

4. Today when the matter is taken up, counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants could not deposit the amount as directed by this Court by order dated 18.1.2024 and the matter may be heard on merit.
5. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that on the basis of general allegations, the entire family has been implicated.

1 6.

entities.text: Danish Malik And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, considering the nature of allegations as well as the conduct of the applicants that they obtained interim order in the garb of sending the matter to the mediation centre and after enjoying the interim order for more than three months now it is stated that the applicants could not deposit the amount, the non compliance of the order dated 18.1.2024 itself is a ground for dismissal of the application.

7. Accordingly, the application is dismissed with the liberty to the applicants that if they appear and move an application for bail before the court below within 15 days from today, then their application shall be considered in view of the law laid down in Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another, (2021) 10 SCC 773.
Order Date :- 15.4.2024
